newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $27 bln 2-, 5-year notes June 24, 25.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $27 bln 2-, 5-year notes June 24, 25.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will sell $15.5 billion of 2-year notes on June 24 and $11.5 bln of 5-year notes on June 25 to refund $29.192 billion of securities maturing June 30 and to pay down about $2.2 billion.
The notes will be issued on June 30. The two-year notes mature on June 30, 1999 and the five-year notes mature on June 30, 2002.
The CUSIP number for the 2-year notes will be 9128272X9 and for the five-year notes will be 9128272Y7.
